name: SelectionCard
label: Selection card
description: Large option cards for high-visibility choices like settings and onboarding, with radio, checkbox or per-card toggle indicators.

props.name: mode
props.description: Selection mode — radio (single), checkbox (multi), or toggle (each card is an on/off switch)

props.name: value
props.description:
Currently selected value(s), controlled: a string for radio, a string[]
otherwise. Leave undefined to let the group keep its own selection,
seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected value(s) on first render when uncontrolled (`value` undefined).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next selection — a string in radio mode, an array otherwise

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name, also the group's aria-label when none is given. When set,
each selected option's `value` submits with an enclosing form through a
hidden input, repeated in checkbox and toggle modes as a set of native
checkboxes does; a disabled option submits nothing. In a form, name the group
with `aria-label` too, so a field key is never what a screen reader announces.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.
